properties.question: Is the 5422 sign here, where Middle Road meets the Pipe Line?
properties.why: OpenStreetMap puts 5422 about 150 m west, where Middle Road meets Wannamanhut Path. The park map puts it here, on the straight Pipe Line between 5425 (north) and 5421 (south).

properties.question: Heading north from 4048 (toward 4049, 4046 and 4066), is this the Pipe Line or Headquarters Path?
properties.why: OpenStreetMap calls the whole track Headquarters Path, from 4012 all the way north past 4066. The park map labels it Headquarters Path only up to 4048, and the Pipe Line from 4048 north.

properties.question: Is the trail from here east to 5370 (along the green dots) Acton Path, or Prescott Foot Path?
properties.why: OpenStreetMap has Prescott Foot Path continuing past 5343 to 5370. The park map labels 5343 to 5370 Acton Path, the north side of the Acton Path loop around Ponkapoag Pond.
